Hello! 👋

Thikaa is an AI-powered customer-engagement platform that replies to your customers 24/7 and sells on your behalf across every channel 🙌

• Answers 24/7 in English and *every* Arabic dialect

*📱 Channels:*
WhatsApp (Direct + Cloud API) · Instagram (DMs + comments) · Facebook · TikTok · Telegram · Email · website widget

*🛒 E-commerce:*

Automatic booking with reminders to cut no-shows.

*📊 AI social-media poster:*
Creates & auto-publishes your posts (scheduling, templates, AI hashtags).

*🎙️ Optional voice agent:*
Replies with voice messages and answers WhatsApp calls.

*💳 Pricing:*
• *Starter* $19.99/mo
• *Professional* $29.99/mo (most popular)
• *Enterprise* $49.99/mo (widest coverage, 24/7 support, lowest per-conversation rate)

7-day free trial + $5 credit, unlimited free WhatsApp Direct. A conversation is billed *once*; every reply inside is free.

*🚀 Get started:*
Sign up at https://thikaa.com/signup.php or get the app:
• iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thikaabot/id6758939870
• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thikaa.app

Our team also offers a *free onboarding session* to connect your channels and build your bot with you.

Want me to help you get started, or do you have a specific question? 😊

channel_metadata.original_message:
🤖 Hi! I'm the AI assistant.

Hello! 👋

Thikaa is an AI-powered customer-engagement platform that replies to your customers 24/7 and sells on your behalf across every channel 🙌

*🤖 Smart bot + unified inbox:*
• Answers 24/7 in English and *every* Arabic dialect
• Understands voice notes and images
• All your chats in one place on web + the iOS/Android app
• One-tap human handoff, then the bot resumes automatically

*📱 Channels:*
WhatsApp (Direct + Cloud API) · Instagram (DMs + comments) · Facebook · TikTok · Telegram · Email · website widget

*🛒 E-commerce:*
Salla, Shopify & WooCommerce integration — the bot knows your products, prices & stock, answers order/shipping questions, and recovers abandoned carts. No store? Build your *own catalog* inside Thikaa and sell from it.

*📅 Appointments:*
Automatic booking with reminders to cut no-shows.

channel_metadata.original_message:
🤖 Hi! I'm the AI assistant.

Hello! 👋

Thikaa is an AI-powered customer-engagement platform that replies to your customers 24/7 and sells on your behalf across every channel 🙌

*🤖 Smart bot + unified inbox:*
• Answers 24/7 in English and *every* Arabic dialect
• Understands voice notes and images
• All your chats in one place on web + the iOS/Android app
• One-tap human handoff, then the bot resumes automatically

*📱 Channels:*
WhatsApp (Direct + Cloud API) · Instagram (DMs + comments) · Facebook · TikTok · Telegram · Email · website widget

*🛒 E-commerce:*
Salla, Shopify & WooCommerce integration — the bot knows your products, prices & stock, answers order/shipping questions, and recovers abandoned carts. No store? Build your *own catalog* inside Thikaa and sell from it.

*📅 Appointments:*
Automatic booking with reminders to cut no-shows.

*📊 AI social-media poster:*
Creates & auto-publishes your posts (scheduling, templates, AI hashtags).

*🎙️ Optional voice agent:*
Replies with voice messages and answers WhatsApp calls.

*💳 Pricing:*
• *Starter* $19.99/mo
• *Professional* $29.99/mo (most popular)
• *Enterprise* $49.99/mo (widest coverage, 24/7 support, lowest per-conversation rate)

7-day free trial + $5 credit, unlimited free WhatsApp Direct. A conversation is billed *once*; every reply inside is free.

*🚀 Get started:*
Sign up at https://thikaa.com/signup.php or get the app:
• iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thikaabot/id6758939870
• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thikaa.app

Our team also offers a *free onboarding session* to connect your channels and build your bot with you.

Want me to help you get started, or do you have a specific question? 😊

🤖 Hi! I'm the AI assistant.

Hello! 👋

Thikaa is an AI-powered customer-engagement platform that replies to your customers 24/7 and sells on your behalf across every channel 🙌

*🤖 Smart bot + unified inbox:*
• Answers 24/7 in English and *every* Arabic dialect
• Understands voice notes and images
• All your chats in one place on web + the iOS/Android app
• One-tap human handoff, then the bot resumes automatically

*📱 Channels:*
WhatsApp (Direct + Cloud API) · Instagram (DMs + comments) · Facebook · TikTok · Telegram · Email · website widget

*🛒 E-commerce:*
Salla, Shopify & WooCommerce integration — the bot knows your products, prices & stock, answers order/shipping questions, and recovers abandoned carts. No store? Build your *own catalog* inside Thikaa and sell from it.

*📅 Appointments:*
Automatic booking with reminders to cut no-shows.

*📊 AI social-media poster:*
Creates & auto-publishes your posts (scheduling, templates, AI hashtags).

*🎙️ Optional voice agent:*
Replies with voice messages and answers WhatsApp calls.

*💳 Pricing:*
• *Starter* $19.99/mo
• *Professional* $29.99/mo (most popular)
• *Enterprise* $49.99/mo (widest coverage, 24/7 support, lowest per-conversation rate)

7-day free trial + $5 credit, unlimited free WhatsApp Direct. A conversation is billed *once*; every reply inside is free.

*🚀 Get started:*
Sign up at https://thikaa.com/signup.php or get the app:
• iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thikaabot/id6758939870
• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.thikaa.app

Our team also offers a *free onboarding session* to connect your channels and build your bot with you.

Want me to help you get started, or do you have a specific question? 😊
